# ECharts 5.5.0

Unmodified `dist/echarts.min.js` from the official pinned npm archive:
https://registry.npmjs.org/echarts/-/echarts-5.5.0.tgz

Apache ECharts: https://echarts.apache.org/ ; Apache License 2.0.
LICENSE, NOTICE and bundled d3 license are copied from that archive.
The `.chunks` copy splits raw bytes into records prefixed C (up to 500 payload bytes)
and N (an original newline) for POSIX/AIX awk;
decoding these records reproduces the original file exactly.
